verdict.rationale: Turso's docs say every database token can be restricted by database, permission level, and expiration. Fine-grained permissions add table- and action-level control, and per-agent databases can be token-scoped through the Platform API, which directly delivers least-privilege credentials for agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of token scoping, evidence that Platform/management API tokens (not just database tokens) can be least-privilege scoped.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Every token can be restricted by database, permission level, and expiration — giving you full control over what each client can and cannot do.
Fine-grained permissions let you control access at the table and action level.
Each entity gets its own isolated SQLite database that you create, token-scope, and tear down via the API.
Programmatically manage databases, groups, organizations, and tokens with the Turso Platform API.
